CIB Curtain - GitHub Pages package

Files:
- index.html
- images/ (all images extracted from the original HTML)

GitHub upload:
1. Upload index.html to the repository root.
2. Create an images folder and upload all files inside images/.
3. Enable Settings -> Pages -> Deploy from branch -> main -> / (root).

To update later, edit/replace index.html or replace the required image in images/.
